description: Per coin the venue with the highest and the lowest annualised funding (current or predicted rates), the spread per year and per day and the smaller open interest of the two legs. A difference between published rates, not an executable return (fees, price moves, funding times). Use it for "where do BTC funding rates differ most?".

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Number of coins, widest spread first (default 10, at most 50).

min_oi_usd.description: Only coins whose thinner leg has at least this open interest (USD).

name: get_funding_spreads

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

spreads.description: Rows of GET /funding/spreads: coin, basis, high, low, spreadApr, spreadDaily, minOpenInterestUsd, venues.

title: Funding spreads between venues
